title: Symphytum officinale tincture for medicinal use
intro: Symphytum officinale tincture is a preparation made from the roots of the comfrey plant, which is known for its healing properties. It is commonly used in herbalism to support bone and tissue repair, particularly for fractures and sprains. The tincture is often applied topically to reduce inflammation and promote healing of wounds and bruises. It is also used internally in small doses to aid in digestive issues and respiratory conditions. However, due to its potential toxicity, it should be used with caution and under the guidance of a qualified herbalist.
